outcome: NOD-like receptor pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome levels
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women divided into three groups: a preterm PROM group (20 cases), a term PROM group (20 cases), and a control group of normal full-term pregnancies without PROM (20 cases).
finding: The concentrations of IL-1b and IL-18, along with the ratios of NLRP3, ASC, and caspase-1-positive macrophages, were significantly elevated in patients with PROM compared to the control group.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of PROM diagnosis or during normal full-term pregnancy for controls.
gest_age: Preterm (for preterm PROM group), term (for TPROM and control groups)
